title: Nuevo Laredo Brings City Services to El Campanario Families
excerpt: Nuevo Laredo's municipal government brought medical care, paperwork help and social-program guidance straight to families in the El Campanario neighborhood on Thursday.
content:
The municipal government of Nuevo Laredo brought medical care, paperwork help and social-program guidance straight to families in the El Campanario neighborhood on Thursday, November 19, through its “Presidencia Cerquita de Ti” outreach day.

The event took place at the Clínica UNE, between Río Grijalva and Río del Carmen streets, where modules from municipal and state agencies served residents of the sector directly, according to CML Noticias.

Families had access to guidance on social programs, food support, legal advice and procedures related to property-tax payments. The Sistema DIF Nuevo Laredo, the Civil Registry, the State Fiscal Office and the College of Notaries of Nuevo Laredo also took part.

Medical care was one of the main draws, with general medicine, nutrition, psychology and comprehensive guidance for women offered on site.

The “Presidencia Cerquita de Ti” program aims to put authorities in direct contact with residents, attend to their needs, guide them on government programs and bring essential services into the colonias.

Sources: CML Noticias, Nov. 19, 2026.
